scope: Isolated simulator service with synthetic speech receipts; no real devices, production data or browser automation performed by this change.

submit.text: 先记录一个观察 / Record one observation

tasks.zh: 缺省 disabled 或旧 state 缺字段时，分句界面仅文字，不发逐段朗读；whole_reply 原流程保持。
tasks.en: With disabled or missing capability fields, segments remain text-only with no per-segment playback request; whole-reply behavior is unchanged.

tasks.zh: after_display 下分别勾选/不勾选发送。每次提交携当时的 auto_speak 与独立 nonce，后台 gate 对应 open/disabled。
tasks.en: Send with the option on and off in after_display mode. Each submission captures its choice and unique nonce, producing open or disabled gates.

tasks.zh: 提交后取消勾选并丢弃响应；随后仅从 state head 匹配 nonce，先关闭本流再允许首段 ACK。
tasks.en: Turn the option off after submitting and lose the response. Match the nonce from state alone, close that stream, then allow its first display ACK.

tasks.zh: 旧提交取消勾选后重新勾选并发送新请求，即使文本相同，旧 nonce/回执也不能关闭新流。
tasks.en: After turning off an older submission, re-enable and send another request with the same text. The old nonce or response must not close the new stream.

tasks.zh: 新 generation 提交回执之后交付旧 generation 的迟到 state，再让 close 失败；新流关闭意图仍保留、ACK 仍暂停。
tasks.en: Deliver an older-generation state after the new submission response, then fail close. Keep the new stream's closing intent and ACK gate.

tasks.zh: 隐藏页面发绑定 hidden close；返回可见仅恢复文字，不恢复声音。状态旧 open 也不能重开。
tasks.en: Hide the page and send its bound hidden close. Returning restores text only; even a stale open state cannot restart speech.

tasks.zh: 明确进入历史页关闭本流，返回实时窗后不自动恢复。普通内容增长不被当成用户停声。
tasks.en: Explicitly open history to close this stream. Returning to live messages does not resume it. Content growth is not treated as a stop command.

tasks.zh: 关闭失败保留提示并按状态轮询重试，始终最多一个 close 在途；文字和已显示前缀不清空。
tasks.en: Keep the close-failure notice and retry on state polling, with at most one close in flight. Preserve text and the displayed prefix.

tasks.zh: completed 流手动朗读只发原 playback API；后端先关闭自动队列。迟到重复 close 不停止新手动播放。
tasks.en: Manually read a completed stream using the existing playback API only; the server first closes its automatic queue. A late duplicate close must not stop manual playback.

tasks.zh: 文字 completed 但音频尚未完成时不显示播报完成；单独关闭声音不改变文字 final、前缀或教学完成事实。
tasks.en: Do not label speech complete merely because text is completed. Closing speech alone preserves final text, the displayed prefix and teaching state.

tasks.zh: provider/final 失败由后端立即停当前段并关闭后续；显示已发生的收据，不把尾段补播或全篇重播。
tasks.en: On provider/final failure, the server stops the current segment and closes the remainder. Keep actual receipts without playing the tail or replaying the whole answer.

tasks.zh: 窄宽布局核对中英的下次发送选项、本条关闭入口、关闭未确认及完成段数；不要把配置 open 写成已经发声。
tasks.en: At narrow and wide widths, verify both languages for the next-send option, per-reply close, unconfirmed close and completed-segment count. Open must not be described as actual audio start.
